"''Graciously accepted, thank you. I would, as Senior Senator, like to yield a moment of my time to the Senior Senator of Alderaan, who has a Point of Order to address.|The Senate's Oathkeeper and Erveen, in a session regarding the Ghorman Massacre|}} '''Erveen''' served as a [[Senior Senator]] in the [[Imperial Senate]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] where she represented [[Hodi]]. In [[2 BBY]], she assisted Senior Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] in invoking [[Article 17-252]] in order to allow Senior Senator [[Mon Mothma]] to give a [[Escape from the Senate|speech]] condemning the [[Ghorman Massacre]]. ==Biography== Erveen was a [[Politics|politician]] who by [[2 BBY]]{{Andor|Messenger}} dates the events of {{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}} to [[2 BBY]]. had become a [[Senior Senator]] representing [[Hodi]] in the in the [[Imperial Senate]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Following the [[Ghorman Massacre]] in 2 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], the senate held a session to discuss the events. Erveen was one of several senators who spoke within the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] as part of the [[Standard day|day's]] agenda. After the Senate's [[Unidentified Oathkeeper|Oathkeeper]], serving as [[Chair of the Senate]], recognized [[Senator]] Erveen, Erveen yielded a moment of her time to [[Bail Prestor Organa]], Senior Senator of [[Alderaan]]. Organa subsequently invoked [[Article 17-252]], and further yielded his time to Senior Senator [[Mon Mothma]] of [[Chandrila]], who used the time to denounce [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] as responsible for the Ghorman Massacre. Mothma subsequently made an [[escape from the Senate]] and stated the [[Declaration of the Rebel Alliance]] above [[Dantooine]]'s orbit, officially creating the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].{{Rebels|Secret Cargo}} ==Personality and traits== Erveen was a human with light skin and [[color|gray]] [[hair]]. She was a confident public speaker and a trusted ally of [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]]. ==Equipment== During Mon Mothma's speech, Erveen wore an elegant maroon [[clothing|dress]] with bands of gold colored crecents running down the front and a gold colored [[belt]]. ==Behind the scenes== Erveen appeared in the [[Welcome to the Rebellion|ninth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' which aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} Erveen was portrayed by [[Jane Bertish]] in the episode. ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{Databank|senator-erveen|Senator Erveen}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=ერვინი }} [[Category:Galactic Empire senators]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]]
